tools.name: trina_dispatch
tools.description: Classify intent from the verbatim user message and return the matching capability prompt. Call first on every turn before any other tool. Returns {ok: true, data: {intent, capability_prompt}}.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event. Accepts attendee_names (display names resolved to emails via Google Contacts) and/or attendees (email addresses). Set add_zoom=true to attach a Zoom meeting via the Google Workspace add-on. Returns {ok: true, data: {event: {id, summary, start, end, html_link, attendees, zoom_url}}}. Error codes: contact_not_found (unresolved_names list included), calendar_api_error.

user_id.description: sender_id from conversation metadata. Used to resolve profile timezone.

start.description: Start datetime, ISO 8601 without UTC offset (e.g. '2026-05-12T14:00:00'). Use the timezone from get_today_date.

end.description: End datetime, ISO 8601 without UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string. Omit to use the user's profile timezone.

attendee_names.description: List of attendee display names. Python resolves each to an email via Google Contacts. Returns contact_not_found if any name cannot be resolved.

add_zoom.description: If true, attach a Zoom meeting via the Google Workspace add-on. Join URL returned in zoom_url.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update fields on an existing Google Calendar event using PATCH (only provided fields are changed). Supports attendee_names resolution via Google Contacts. Returns {ok: true, data: {event: {id, summary, start, end, html_link, attendees, zoom_url}}}.

event_id.description: Google Calendar event ID. Obtain from list_events.

start.description: New start datetime, ISO 8601 without UTC offset.

end.description: New end datetime, ISO 8601 without UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string for start/end interpretation.

attendees.description: Replace attendee list with these email addresses.

attendee_names.description: Replace attendee list with these display names (resolved via Google Contacts).

add_zoom.description: If true, add a Zoom meeting to this event.

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.description: Cancel (delete) a Google Calendar event. Sends cancellation notifications to attendees by default. Returns {ok: true, data: {cancelled: true, event_id: '...'}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID from conversation metadata. Used to tag the observability span.

event_id.description: Google Calendar event ID. Obtain from list_events.

send_updates.description: 'all' (default), 'externalOnly', or 'none'. Controls whether attendees are notified.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search Google Contacts by name or email. Returns {ok: true, data: {contacts: [{resource_name, name, email, phone, all_emails}], total_count}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID from conversation metadata. Used to tag the observability span.

query.description: Name or email to search for.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new Google Contact. Returns {ok: true, data: {contact: {resource_name, name, email, phone, company, title}}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID from conversation metadata. Used to tag the observability span.

first_name.description: Given name (used alongside last_name for structured name storage).

phone_type.description: Phone type: mobile (default), work, or home.

email_type.description: Email type: work (default), home, or other.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming Google Calendar events. Returns {ok: true, data: {events: [{id, summary, start, end, attendees, location, description, html_link}]}}. Event times are normalized to the user's profile timezone by default. Pass timezone to override (e.g. to show times in a different city).

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted). Used to resolve the user's profile timezone for event time normalization.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string to override the user's profile timezone (e.g. 'Europe/London'). Resolve city names to IANA strings before passing. Omit to use the user's profile timezone.

time_min.description: Start of time range, ISO 8601 (default: now)

time_max.description: End of time range, ISO 8601 (default: now + 7 days)

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 25)

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get a single Google Calendar event by ID. Returns {ok: true, data: {event: {...}}} with the full event object. Event times are normalized to the user's profile timezone by default. Pass timezone to override.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted). Used to resolve the user's profile timezone for event time normalization.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string to override the user's profile timezone (e.g. 'Europe/London'). Resolve city names to IANA strings before passing. Omit to use the user's profile timezone.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Read or create/update a user profile. Call with {user_id} only to check registration status and return the current profile. Call with {user_id, name, timezone} to create or update. timezone must be a valid IANA string (e.g. 'America/Denver') — the LLM resolves city names to IANA strings before calling. Returns {ok: true, data: {profile: {user_id, name, timezone, registered_at, updated_at}}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

timezone.description: IANA timezone string resolved by the LLM from the user's city (e.g. 'America/Denver', 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London').

tools.name: complete
tools.description: Mark a GTD task or idea as done. Returns {ok: true, data: {completed: {id, title, status, completed_at, ...}}}. Only task and idea are supported. Always call query_tasks or query_ideas first to obtain the record_id.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

record_id.description: The id field of the record to complete. Obtain from a prior query_tasks or query_ideas call.

record_type.description: Record type: 'task' or 'idea'. Must match the type returned by the query.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Capture a GTD record (task, idea, or parking_lot). Returns {ok: true, data: {captured: {id, ...}}} where captured contains type-specific fields. task: id, title, context, project, priority, waiting_for, due_date, notes, status, created_at, updated_at, last_reviewed, completed_at. idea: id, title, topic, content, status, created_at, updated_at, last_reviewed, completed_at. parking_lot: id, content, reason, status, created_at, updated_at, last_reviewed, completed_at. record_type, source, telegram_chat_id excluded.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

record.description: The assembled GTD record. Must include record_type and required fields for that type.

tools.name: query_tasks
tools.description: Query GTD tasks with optional filters. Returns {ok: true, data: {items, total_count, truncated}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

due_date_before.description: Return tasks with due_date <= this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

due_date_after.description: Return tasks with due_date >= this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

has_waiting_for.description: true: only tasks with waiting_for set; false: only tasks without

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 10; max: 25)

tools.name: query_ideas
tools.description: Query GTD ideas. Returns {ok: true, data: {items, total_count, truncated}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 10; max: 25)

tools.name: query_parking_lot
tools.description: Query GTD parking lot items. Returns {ok: true, data: {items, total_count, truncated}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 10; max: 25)

tools.name: review
tools.description: Run a structured GTD review pass; stamp stale records per record type. Returns {ok: true, data: {reviewed_at: <iso>, by_type: {tasks: {items, total_count, truncated}, ideas: {items, total_count, truncated}, parking_lot: {items, total_count, truncated}}}}. On partial stamp failure: {ok: false, error: {code: "storage_unavailable", path: <failing-file>, ...}}.

user_id.description: Sender's Telegram user ID. Read sender_id from the conversation metadata (untrusted).

record_types.description: Record types to include in the review pass. Allowed values: 'tasks', 'ideas', 'parking_lot'. Default: all three. Omit to review all types.

stale_for_days.description: Days before a record is considered stale (default: 7). Records not reviewed within this window are returned and stamped.

limit_per_type.description: Maximum records to stamp per record type (default: 25; max: 25).
